source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists
difficultyNote: `difficulty` is the 2D6 the caster must equal or beat. Null means the entry succeeds automatically and is never rolled for.

amazonRituals.name: Amazon Rituals
amazonRituals.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Singing Wind
spells.effect: Any model within 10" is held until the start of the Amazon player's next turn: it cannot move, shoot or cast spells, but may defend itself in hand-to-hand combat. Models affected automatically go last in combat.

spells.name: Serpent's Strength
spells.effect: Any model within 8" of the Priestess, including herself, adds +1 Strength until the end of their next turn. Cannot be cast if the Priestess is in close combat during her Shooting phase; the effect continues if she enters combat afterwards.

spells.name: Wendala's Maelstrom
spells.effect: A storm extends 18" from the Priestess. All enemy attempts to shoot missile weapons are at -1 to hit, until the start of the Amazon player's next turn.

spells.name: Shield of Thorns
spells.effect: The Priestess becomes immune to ranged and magical attacks. Models may still charge her, but the thorns negate all strikes by her and her enemies in the first round of combat. Cannot be cast while in hand-to-hand combat.

spells.name: The Living Jungle
spells.effect: Pick one model within 12". It takes 1D6 Strength 2 hits with no armour saves allowed apart from Ward saves. Dodge saves cannot be used against the swarm.

spells.name: Siren's Dreams
spells.effect: All Leadership tests for the opposing warband within 12" are made at -1 until the end of the opposing player's next turn. Lizardmen and Undead are immune.

nurgleRituals.name: Nurgle Rituals
nurgleRituals.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Daemonic Vigour
spells.effect: Any Plague Bearers or Nurglings within 8" of the Master increase their Daemonic Aura save from 5+ to 4+ until the beginning of their next turn.

spells.name: Buboes
spells.effect: Range 8", affects a single enemy warrior. The warrior must pass a Toughness test or lose a Wound. No armour saves allowed.

spells.name: Stench of Nurgle
spells.effect: Range 6", affects all living creatures, friend or foe. Each enemy warrior in range must pass a Toughness test or lose an Attack until their next turn.

spells.name: Pestilence
spells.effect: All enemy models within 12" of the Master suffer a Strength 3 hit. No armour saves allowed.

spells.name: Scabrous Hide
spells.effect: The Master has an armour save of 2+, replacing any normal armour save, until the beginning of his next Shooting phase.

spells.name: Nurgle's Rot
spells.effect: All enemy models in base contact with the Master must immediately test against their Toughness or contract Nurgle's Rot.

chaosRituals.name: Chaos Rituals
usedBy: Marauders of Chaos Seer with the Mark of Chaos Undivided
chaosRituals.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Vision of Torment
spells.effect: Range 6", cast on the closest enemy model; if the caster is in hand-to-hand combat he must choose a target in base contact. The affected model is immediately stunned, or knocked down if it cannot be stunned.

spells.name: Eye of God
spells.effect: Usable successfully only once per battle. Choose any single model within 6", friend or foe, and roll a D6.

subTable.effect: The model is taken out of action immediately. It does not roll on the Serious Injury chart after the battle.
The model gains +1 to any one characteristic for this battle, chosen by the player who cast the spell.
The model gains +1 to all of its characteristics for the duration of the battle.

spells.name: Dark Blood
spells.effect: Range 8", causing D3 Strength 5 hits on the first model in its path. Afterwards the caster rolls on the Injury table for himself, treating an out-of-action result as stunned instead.

spells.name: Lure of Chaos
spells.effect: Range 12", cast on the closest enemy model. Roll a D6 and add the caster's Leadership; the target rolls a D6 and adds its own. If the caster wins he controls the model until it passes a Leadership test in its own recovery phase. The model may not commit suicide, but can attack its own side and will not fight the caster's warband. Any of the caster's warriors it was engaged with immediately move 1" apart.
spells.errata: The source marks the final clause as queried.

spells.name: Wings of Darkness
spells.effect: The caster may immediately move anywhere within 12", including into base contact with an enemy, counting as charging. If he engages a fleeing enemy he scores one automatic hit in the close combat phase, and his opponent then flees again if it survives.

spells.name: Word of Pain
spells.effect: All models within 3" of the caster, friend or foe, suffer one Strength 3 hit. No armour saves allowed.

lesserMagic.name: Lesser Magic
lesserMagic.notes: Also called hedge magic: the recourse of wizards without the tradition and grimoires of Necromancers and Chaos Mages.
lesserMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Fires of U'Zhul
spells.effect: Range 18", causing one Strength 4 hit on the first model in its path. Armour saves are taken as normal, with the -1 modifier.

spells.name: Flight of Zimmeran
spells.effect: The wizard may immediately move anywhere within 12", including into base contact with an enemy, counting as charging. If he engages a fleeing enemy he scores one automatic hit in the close combat phase, and his opponent then flees again if it survives.
spells.errata: The source marks the final clause as queried.

spells.name: Dread of Aramar
spells.effect: A single model within 12" must pass a Leadership test or flee 2D6" directly away. If it flees it tests again at the start of each of its own movement phases, continuing to flee until it passes. Does not affect Undead or any model immune to fear.

spells.name: Silver Arrows of Arha
spells.effect: Cannot be cast while in hand-to-hand combat. Summons D6+2 arrows, range 24", shot against one enemy model. Use the wizard's own Ballistic Skill to hit, ignoring movement, range and cover penalties. Each arrow causes one Strength 3 hit.
spells.errata: The source marks the single-target restriction as amended and the movement penalty as queried.

spells.name: Luck of Shemtek
spells.effect: The wizard may re-roll all his failed dice rolls; the second result stands. Lasts until the beginning of his own next turn.

spells.name: Sword of Rezhebel
spells.effect: A flaming sword gives the wizard +1 Attack, +2 Strength and +2 Weapon Skill. Take a Leadership test at the beginning of each of the wizard's own turns; if it fails, the sword disappears.

lizardmenMagic.name: Lizardmen Magic
lizardmenMagic.notes: Works like the Prayers of Sigmar and may be used even while the Skink Priest is wearing armour.
lizardmenMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Chotec's Wrath
spells.effect: A lightning bolt strikes the closest enemy model within 10" for a single Strength 5 hit. Add +1 Strength and +1 to the roll on the Injury table if that model is wearing light, heavy, Ithilmar or Gromril armour.

spells.name: Sotec's Blessing
spells.effect: Cast on a single model within 6" or on the Priest himself; roll a D6 for the blessing. The effect remains until the Priest or the model is stunned or taken out of action. Only one model may be affected at a time.

subTable.effect: +1 BS, or +1 to hit in close combat.

spells.name: Huanchi's Stealth
spells.effect: All Skinks within 6" of the Priest, including himself, may immediately go into hiding if in cover — even if they ran this movement phase or have already shot with a missile weapon.

spells.name: The Old Ones' Protection
spells.effect: The Priest and any Lizardmen within 4" gain a 4+ save against the effects of spells and prayers. Remains in play until the Priest is taken out of action.

spells.name: Tinci's Rage
spells.effect: A single Lizardman within 6", or the Priest himself, is overtaken by rage: it follows the rules for Frenzy and gains +1 Strength. Remains in play until the Priest or the model is stunned or taken out of action. At the beginning of each turn the Priest must pass a Leadership roll to keep it going. Only one model may be affected at a time, though the Priest may release it at the beginning of his turn to recast on another model later in the shooting phase.

spells.name: Itzl's Speed
spells.effect: A single Lizardman within 6", or the Priest himself, may make an additional sprint of up to 4". This counts as running, may not be used by a model that has already fired a missile weapon, and may not be used to charge.

magicOfTheHornedRat.name: Magic of the Horned Rat
magicOfTheHornedRat.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Warpfire
spells.effect: Range 8", hitting the first model in its path. Causes D3 Strength 4 hits on the target and one Strength 3 hit on each model within 2" of it.

spells.name: Children of the Horned Rat
spells.effect: Must be used before the game and only once. Summons D3 Giant Rats, placed within 6" of the Sorcerer. They disappear after the battle and do not count towards the maximum size of the warband.

spells.name: Gnawdoom
spells.effect: Causes 2D6 Strength 1 hits on a single model within 8" of the caster.

spells.name: Black Fury
spells.effect: The Sorcerer may immediately charge any enemy model within 12", ignoring terrain and interposing models, and gains 2 extra Attacks and +1 Strength during this turn's hand-to-hand combat phase only.

spells.name: Eye of the Warp
spells.effect: All standing models in base contact with the Sorcerer take an immediate Leadership test. Each that fails suffers a Strength 3 hit and must run 2D6" directly away from the Sorcerer, as if it had lost its nerve fighting more than one opponent.

spells.name: Sorcerer's Curse
spells.effect: Range 12", affecting a single model. The target must re-roll any successful armour saves and to-hit rolls during the Skaven hand-to-hand phase and its own next shooting and hand-to-hand combat phases.

necromancy.name: Necromancy
necromancy.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Lifestealer
spells.effect: Choose a single model within 6". It suffers a wound with no save allowed, and the Necromancer gains an extra wound for the duration of the battle, which may take him above his original maximum. Does not affect the Possessed or any Undead models.

spells.name: Re-Animation
spells.effect: One Zombie that went out of action during the last hand-to-hand combat or Shooting phase immediately returns to the battle, placed within 6" of the Necromancer. It cannot be placed straight into hand-to-hand combat with an enemy model.
spells.errata: The source marks the returning-Zombie clause as amended.

spells.name: Death Vision
spells.effect: The Necromancer causes fear in his enemies for the duration of the battle.

spells.name: Spell of Doom
spells.effect: Choose one enemy model within 12". It must immediately roll equal to or less than its Strength on a D6, or you may roll on the Injury table to see what happens to it.

spells.name: Call of Vanhel
spells.effect: A single Zombie or Dire Wolf within 6" of the Necromancer may immediately move again up to its maximum Movement. If this brings it into base contact with an enemy model, it counts as charging.

spells.name: Spell of Awakening
spells.effect: If an enemy Hero is killed — your opponent rolls 11-15 on the Serious Injury chart after the battle — the Necromancer may raise him to fight as a Zombie. The dead Hero keeps his characteristics, weapons and armour but may not use any other equipment or skills, may no longer run, counts as a Henchman group on his own, and may not gain experience. He otherwise follows the normal Zombie rules.
spells.errata: The source marks the new Zombie's status as queried and its retained profile as amended.

prayersOfSigmar.name: Prayers of Sigmar
prayersOfSigmar.notes: May be used while wearing armour. Prayers are not regarded as spells, so protection against spells does not affect them.
prayersOfSigmar.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: The Hammer of Sigmar
spells.effect: The wielder gains +2 Strength in hand-to-hand combat and all hits he inflicts cause double damage — 2 wounds instead of 1.
spells.errata: The source marks the requirement to test each Shooting phase as queried.

spells.name: Hearts of Steel
spells.effect: Allied warriors within 8" become immune to fear and to all alone tests, and the whole warband gains +1 to any Rout tests. Lasts until the caster is knocked down, stunned or put out of action. Effects are not cumulative if cast again.
spells.errata: The source marks the non-cumulative clause as both queried and amended.

spells.name: Soulfire
spells.effect: All enemy models within 4" suffer a Strength 3 hit with no armour saves allowed. Undead and Possessed models in range suffer a Strength 5 hit instead.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.effect: The Priest is immune to all spells. Roll at the beginning of each turn in the recovery phase; on a 1 or 2 the shield disappears.

spells.name: Healing Hand
spells.effect: Any one model within 2" of the Priest, including himself, is restored to its full quota of Wounds. In addition, any friendly models within 2" that are stunned or knocked down immediately stand up and continue fighting as normal.

spells.name: Armour of Righteousness
spells.effect: The Priest has an armour save of 2+, replacing his normal armour save, and causes fear in his enemies, and is therefore immune to fear himself. Lasts until the beginning of the Priest's next Shooting phase.

prayersOfTaal.name: Prayers of Taal
prayersOfTaal.notes: Work like the Prayers of Sigmar. The Priest wears no armour — which the unit entry narrows to heavy armour only, so light armour, a helmet and a shield are allowed.
prayersOfTaal.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Stag's Leap
spells.effect: The Priest may immediately move anywhere within 9", including into base contact with an enemy, counting as charging and gaining +1 Strength for his first round of attacks. If he engages a fleeing enemy he scores one automatic hit at +1 Strength in the close combat phase, and his opponent then flees again if it survives.

spells.name: Blessed Ale
spells.effect: Any one model within 2" of the Priest, including himself, is restored to its full quota of Wounds. In addition, any living enemy models within 2" — not Undead or Possessed — lose 1 Attack during the next round of combat.

spells.name: Bear's Paw
spells.effect: The Priest or a single friendly model within 6" gains +2 Strength until the Priest's next turn.

spells.name: Earthshudder
spells.effect: Cast on a single building within 4". Any enemy models touching it suffer a single Strength 3 hit. The building then collapses: models on it count as having fallen to the ground, and the terrain feature is removed from the board for the rest of the game.

spells.name: Tanglefoot
spells.effect: All models within 12" of the Priest, friend as well as foe, may move only at half speed until the next shooting phase. Ostlander Jaegers and friendly Horned Hunter Zealots are unaffected.

spells.name: Summon Squirrels
spells.effect: One enemy model within 12" of the Priest suffers 2D6 Strength 1 hits. No armour saves allowed.

waaaghMagic.name: Waaagh! Magic
waaaghMagic.notes: Rituals of a sort: howling prayers to the Orc gods Gork and Mork.
waaaghMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Led'z Go
spells.effect: Any Orc or Goblin within 4" of the Shaman automatically strikes first in hand-to-hand combat regardless of other circumstances. Lasts until the caster is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action.

spells.name: Oi! Gerroff!
spells.effect: Range 8". Moves any enemy model within range D6" directly away from the Shaman. If the target collides with another model or a building, both suffer one Strength 3 hit. May not be cast on models in hand-to-hand combat.

spells.name: Zzap!
spells.effect: Range 12". Causes D3 Strength 4 hits on the closest enemy target, with no armour saves allowed.

spells.name: Fooled Ya!
spells.effect: No enemy may charge the Shaman during their next turn. If the Shaman is engaged in hand-to-hand combat he may immediately move 4" away.

spells.name: Clubba
spells.effect: An ectoplasmic club counts as a normal club with a +2 Strength bonus and gives the Shaman +1 Attack. Lasts until the Shaman suffers a wound.

spells.name: Fire of Gork
spells.effect: Range 12". Two bolts each cause D3 Strength 3 hits; both may be fired at the closest enemy target or split between the two closest enemy targets.

arabianElementalMagic.name: Arabian Elemental Magic
arabianElementalMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Riding the Wind
spells.effect: . This spell is cast at the beginning of the caster's Movement phase. The caster may move up to 12+D6" anywhere on the battlefield, ignoring any intervening terrain; this counts as the caster's movement for that turn. This spell may not be used to move the caster into base contact with an enemy warrior, but the caster may shoot as normal (with a -1 penalty for having moved).

spells.name: Skin of Stone
spells.effect: This spell may be cast on any friendly warrior within 6". The target gains +2 to his armour save but suffers a -1 penalty to Initiative. The spell may be maintained each turn, providing the affected warrior remains within 6" of the caster and the caster can pass a Difficulty test. If the caster is more than 6" away from the affected warrior in the Recovery phase, the spell cannot be maintained and wears off. Only one warrior may be affected by a Stone Skin spell at any one time, although the caster is free to cast other spells while maintaining the Stone Skin.

spells.name: Burning Hand
spells.effect: This spell is cast at the beginning of the Combat phase. The caster may sacrifice all of his normal attacks to make one hand-to-hand attack at Strength 5, causing 2 wounds. If the enemy warrior is successfully hit, he is set on fire on a roll of 4+. This spell lasts for one round only.

spells.name: Quicksand
spells.effect: This spell is cast at any warrior within 6". The water floods the area for 3" around the targeted warrior. The effect lasts until the beginning of the caster's next Recovery phase. All warriors within the quicksand must pass a Strength test or be unable to move. Warriors in combat cannot attack but may defend themselves.

spells.name: Storm of Magic
spells.effect: The caster may target any warrior within 12". If the spell is successfully cast, the target is struck by a bolt of energy and takes one S5 hit. Armour saves may be taken as normal.

spells.name: Blessing of the Elements
spells.effect: In the post-battle sequence, the player may re-roll any one dice or modify one dice by +1/-1. If the caster was taken out of action, this spell may not be cast.

chaosDwarfsMagic.name: Chaos Dwarfs Magic
usedBy: The Sons of Hashut Apprentice Sorcerer
chaosDwarfsMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Spectre of Hashut
spells.effect: Designate the enemy miniature closest to the wizard's miniature within 10". That miniature is automatically stunned.

spells.name: Stone Statue
spells.effect: Choose an enemy miniature that is within 12" of you and is in your line of sight. For the rest of the turn and the following turn, the miniature will not be able to do anything. If attacked in melee, the miniature will suffer an automatic hit. If it is shot, the miniature that shoots at it will get a +1 bonus on hit.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.effect: This spell has a range of 16" and requires line of sight. The target receives an automatic hit of strength 4.

spells.name: Vanish
spells.effect: The wizard may immediately make a move of up to 6" in any direction and may enter or leave combat without penalty. If he enters combat, he is considered to be making a charge move.

spells.name: Eruption
spells.effect: All miniatures within a distance of up to 4" (friend or foe) suffer an automatic hit of Strength 4. After resolving the effects of this hit, the sorcerer will not be able to cast any more spells until the next turn and will suffer a -1 to his Toughness attribute.

spells.name: Eye of Hashut
spells.effect: Choose a friendly miniature within 12" and roll 1D6. Hobgoblins always subtract 1 from the result. You may use the Eye of Hashut successfully only once per battle. 1D6 | Result; 1 | Hashut does not trust you. The miniature is immediately out of action, although it will not roll on the serious injury table during the post-battle sequence.; 2-5 | Hashut trusts you. The miniature adds +1 to one of its attributes for the rest of the game.; 6 | Hashut favors you. The miniature adds +1 to all attributes for the rest of the game.

charmsAndHexes.name: Charms & Hexes
charmsAndHexes.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Scry
spells.effect: For the duration of the turn one hero or henchman may re-roll D3 dice rolls and add +1 or -1 to the result.

spells.name: Curse
spells.effect: One enemy model within 12" of the Witch must re-roll all successful dice rolls for the duration of this and their next turn.

spells.name: Dust of the Blind
spells.effect: One enemy model within 16" of the Witch is struck instantly blind. They may not shoot, charge or run, are at half Weapon Skill and will move in a random direction at the start of their turn. The Blindness lasts until the Witch casts another spell or moves.

spells.name: Age of Stone
spells.effect: One enemy model within 12" of the Witch will be severely debilitated and all of their characteristics are reduced by -1 for the duration of this and their next turn.

spells.name: Warrior's Bane
spells.effect: One enemy model within 18" of the Witch will be unable to use any of their weapons as they perpetually slip from their grasp. They will be unable to shoot and count as fighting with fists in Hand-to-Hand combat. The enchantment lasts for the duration of this and their next turn.

spells.name: Cure
spells.effect: All friendly models within 6" of the Witch have a single wound healed. In addition any stunned or knocked down models may immediately stand up.

darkElfMagic.name: Dark Elf Magic
darkElfMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Doombolt
spells.effect: The bolt of doom may be targeted at any enemy model in line of sight. The Doombolt has an 18" range and causes a Strength 5 hit. If the target model is wounded, then the next closest model within 6" is also hit on a 4+, at -1 Strength than the previous hit. The bolt will keep leaping until there are no more targets within range or until its Strength drops to a one. Each model can only be hit by a bolt once per turn. Take armour saves as normal.

spells.name: Word of Pain
spells.effect: The spell may be cast at an enemy model within 12". The victim must re-roll all successful hand to hand or missile attacks and all to wound rolls. If the victim wishes to charge, he must pass a successful Leadership test first. Lasts until the beginning of the next Dark Elf turn.

spells.name: Soul Stealer
spells.effect: Once successfully cast, the Sorceress must make a to hit roll against a model in base contact. If the attack hits, the opponent suffers a wound with no armour save possible. The Sorceress feeds on this life-force and adds one wound to her profile. The Sorceress can never have more than one extra wound from this spell and the extra wound is lost at the end of the battle.

spells.name: Flamesword
spells.effect: The Sorceress may choose the hand-to-hand combat weapon of a member of her warband within 6" to be engulfed in flames. The weapon acts as normal but grants +2 Strength and ignores armour saves. The spell lasts until the Sorceress' next shooting phase.

spells.name: Deathspasm
spells.effect: The Deathspasm has a range of 6" and must be cast on the closest enemy model. The affected model must roll on the injury chart. If successfully cast, the casting Sorceress is immediately knocked down.

spells.name: Witch Flight
spells.effect: The Sorceress may immediately move anywhere within 12" and may count as charging. If she engages a fleeing enemy in the close combat phase she will score 1 automatic hit and the opponent will flee again.

forestGoblinMagic.name: Forest Goblin Magic
forestGoblinMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Wind of Gork
spells.effect: A blast of foul flatulence signals Gork's wrath. Range: 12". The first model in its path must roll under its Toughness or take a S2 hit and be knocked down automatically.

spells.name: Gaze of Mork
spells.effect: Range 12". D3 S3 hits strike the first model in their path.

spells.name: 'Eadbanger
spells.effect: Range 6". Fire bolts equal to the number of the Shaman's Attacks. Resolve with Strength equal to the Shaman's Toughness at the first model in their path. After the bolts effects are resolved, roll a die. On a 1 the Shaman has drawn upon too much power. The Shaman collapses and goes out of action.

spells.name: Leap of Waaagh!
spells.effect: The Shaman or any other Goblin within 3" may be moved up to 12". If this move brings them into close combat, they count as charging in the close combat phase.

spells.name: Idol of Gork
spells.effect: The Shaman gains +1 WS, +1 S, and +1 A. This enhancement lasts until the Shaman takes a wound.

spells.name: 'Ere we go
spells.effect: All friendly models within 6" of the Shaman treat stunned results on the injury table as knocked down instead. The effects last until the Shaman takes a wound.

funeraryRites.name: Funerary Rites
funeraryRites.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Morr's Protection
spells.effect: Any Magical attacks made by a Necromancer, a Magister or Daemons, which would be considered a direct attack on the priest, will be negated if this rite is successful.

spells.name: Death Holds No Fear
spells.effect: The priest of Morr is now Fearless for the remainder of the game.

spells.name: Sanctity of the Fallen
spells.effect: The priest of Morr may attempt to perform the Rite of Sanctity on a model (friend or foe) who has been taken Out of Action. The priest of Morr must be within 6" of the model in question. If successful, the model may not be raised up by a Necromancer.

spells.name: Hand of Morr
spells.effect: The priest of Morr must be in base-to-base contact with an Undead model. Before Hand-to-Hand combat occurs, the priest of Morr may attempt to use the Hand of Morr rite. If successful the foe immediately goes out of action (this affects Zombies, Dire Wolves and Vampires). Ghouls and Possessed affected by this rite will immediately flee their full Move away from the priest of Morr.

spells.name: Do you know who I am?
spells.effect: This rite has a range of 6" and must be directed at the closest Undead model first, or if no Undead are within range, at the next closest human servant of the Undead (Dregs, Ghouls, Necromancers), or finally at any model. If successful, that model is immediately Stunned. If the model cannot be Stunned, then it is Knocked Down instead.

spells.name: I am death!
spells.effect: This spell gives the priest of Morr a 6+ armour save and increases their WS by either +1 or makes it 4, whichever is greater.

goblinMagic.name: Goblin Magic
goblinMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Wind of Gork
spells.effect: Range: 12". The first model in its path must roll under its Toughness or take a Strength 2 hit and be knocked down automatically.

spells.name: Gaze of Mork
spells.effect: Range: 12". D3 Strength 3 hits strike the first model in their path.

spells.name: 'Eadbanger
spells.effect: Range: 6". Fire bolts equal to the number of the Shaman's Base Attacks. Resolve with Strength equal to the Shaman's Toughness at the first model in their path. After the bolts effects are resolved, roll a die. On a 1 the Shaman has drawn upon too much power, they collapse and goes Out of Action.

spells.name: Leap of Waaagh!
spells.effect: The Shaman or any other Goblin within 3" may be moved up to 12", ignoring terrain. If this move brings them into close combat, they count as charging in the close combat phase.

spells.name: Idol of Gork
spells.effect: The Shaman gains +1 WS, +1 S, and +1 A. This enhancement lasts until the Shaman takes a wound.

spells.name: 'Ere we go!
spells.effect: All friendly models within 6" of the Shaman treat stunned results on the Injury Table as knocked down instead. The effects last until the Shaman takes a wound.

ladysPrayers.name: Lady's Prayers
ladysPrayers.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Lady's Favors
spells.effect: All your heroes count as having Lucky Charms for this battle and ignore the first hit against them on a D6 roll of 4+. If they already own Lucky Charms, they may reroll a failed Lucky Charm save, accepting the second result.

spells.name: Blessed Protection
spells.effect: The Damsel and any Bretonnians within 6" of her gain an unmodified ward save of 4+ against the effects of spells or prayers. Test each shooting phase: on a roll of 1 or 2, the spell dissipates.

spells.name: Swiftstride
spells.effect: The damsel may pick a friendly hero or henchman (including herself) within 12" that charged or failed a charge this turn. That warrior gains +1 to hit on all attacks they make until the end of the turn. In addition, if they are not in combat, they may make an additional move of 1D6" towards an enemy (if they move into base contact with an enemy, this counts as a charge).

spells.name: Lady's Scorn
spells.effect: Anyone attempting to shoot at the Damsel must first pass a Leadership test, or else they are unable to fire this turn. This includes Silver Arrows, Crossbow Pistols, Hand-to-Hand Pistols, and Template shot weapons that she is within the path of (like Blunderbusses.) This spell lasts until the end of the game.

spells.name: Elixir of Life
spells.effect: Any one model within 4" of the Damsel (including herself) may be healed. The warrior is restored to his full quota of Wounds. In addition, if any friendly models within 4" are stunned or knocked down, they immediately come to their senses, stand up, and continue fighting as normal.

spells.name: Guiding Vision
spells.effect: The Damsel picks a friendly hero or henchman within 8". Until the start of your next shooting phase, that warrior may re-roll one die roll they make and add +1 or -1 to the result.

loreOfDarkness.name: Lore of Darkness
loreOfDarkness.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Bolt of Dark Light
spells.effect: The bolt has a range of 12" and causes a single Strength 5 hit against the first model in its path.

spells.name: Betrayal in Death
spells.effect: This spell will affect all enemy models slain in the shooting phase or close combat and lasts until the start of the caster's next turn. The enemies will reanimate as they are killed and attack their comrades. If not in combat the model will shoot if able, or charge if it has no missile weapons. If in combat the enemy will only make a single attack. After attacking the enemy will fall once more, dead.

spells.name: Nightmare
spells.effect: This spell may be cast upon an enemy model within 18" of the caster. The model must take an immediate fear test as if charged by a fear-causing enemy. If failed the model flees 2D6" away from the Dark Emissary.

spells.name: Curse of the Dark Master
spells.effect: This spell can be cast upon a single model within 24" of the caster. All that model's rolls to hit for both shooting and combat are reduced by -1 until the start of the caster' next turn.

spells.name: Fog of Death
spells.effect: This spell affects every model on the board except the Dark Emissary. Enemy models are affected on a roll of 4+, while friendly models are only affected on a 6+. All models attacked by the nightmare creatures suffer a strength 2 hit. The fog lasts until the start of the caster's next turn and reduces line of sigh to 3D6" for all warriors present which will affect shooting, charging etc.

spells.name: Coils of the Serpent
spells.effect: This spell may be cast upon a single enemy model within 6" of the caster. The model must take an immediate toughness test to fight off the deadly serpent. If failed the model is crushed to death and out of action. No saves of any kind will protect against this magic.

loreOfLight.name: Lore of Light
loreOfLight.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Wings of Fate
spells.effect: The flock has a range of 18" and may attack any model within this range of the Truthsayer. The enemy model suffers D3 Strength 2 hits.

spells.name: Light of Battle
spells.effect: This spell may be cast upon a friendly model within 12" of the caster. That model has an additional save of 5+ that can be reduced in any way against all attacks until the start of the Truthsayer's next turn.

spells.name: Gift of Life
spells.effect: This spell may be cast upon a friendly model slain in the previous enemy turn. The model is immediately restored back to 1 wound remaining and should be placed as accurately as possible where they fell.

spells.name: Blessing of Valour
spells.effect: This spell may be cast upon a single friendly model within 24". The model is infused with strength and courage, gaining +1 to all hit rolls in close combat for the duration of the turn.

spells.name: Boon of Courage
spells.effect: This spell affects all friendly models within 12". The models are completely immune to the effects of psychology and all alone tests until the end of the Truthsayer's next turn.

spells.name: Voice of Command
spells.effect: This spell affects one model within 24" of the Truthsayer. That model may do nothing in its next turn other than defend itself in combat. It may not move, shoot, attack or perform any other action.

mortuaryCultScrolls.name: Mortuary Cult Scrolls
mortuaryCultScrolls.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Menkare's scroll of Urgency
spells.effect: A single Skeleton Soldier within 6" may immediately move again up to its maximum Movement distance, ie, 4". If this takes the model into base contact with an enemy model, it counts as charging.

spells.name: Horrebe's Curse of the Mummy
spells.effect: The target must be in base-to-base contact with a Mummy and within 18" of the Liche Priest. if the spell is cast successfully, the enemy model has a -1 penalty on all to hit and to wound rolls, and on all armour saves. This lasts until the stare of the next Tomb Guardian Shooting phase.

spells.name: Tawosret's Scroll of Tomb Dust
spells.effect: The warrior is automatically -knocked down- as he chokes on the sand. This spell only affects a living model.

spells.name: Neferre's Scroll of Quaking Horror
spells.effect: The model must pass a Leadership test or flee 2D6" directly away from the Liche Priest. The warrior will continue to flee in each Movement phase until he makes a successful Rally test in the Recovery phase. This spell has no effect on Undead models or models that are immune to psychology.

spells.name: Merneptah's Scroll of the Scarab Song
spells.effect: A single model within 8" of the Liche Priest suffers 2D6 Strength 1 hits. In addition, that model may not be shot at for the rest of the Tomb Guards Shooting phase, nor may he fight or be fought in hand-to-hand combat. If the model is already in hand-to-hand combat, move him 1" away from the combat as he staggers about in agony. Unless he suffers an actual injury the warrior counts as having just stood up in the next turn.

spells.name: Djedre's summonation of the Vengeful Dead
spells.effect: The Liche Priest may re-animate a Skeleton Soldier that went -out of action- during the last turn. Place the model anywhere within 6" of the Liche Priest, but not straight into hand-to-hand combat with an enemy model.

necromancyRestlessDead.name: Necromancy (The Restless Dead)
necromancyRestlessDead.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Spell of Awakening
spells.effect: If an enemy Hero is killed (i.e. your opponent rolls 11-15 on the serious injury chart after the battle), then the sorcerer may raise him to fight as a Zombie in his servitude. The dead Hero retains his characteristics and all his weapons and armour but may not use any equipment or skills. He may no longer run, counts as a Henchmen group on his own and does not gain additional experience.

spells.name: Lifestealer
spells.effect: Choose a single model within 6". The target suffers a wound, (no saves allowed) and the sorcerer gains an extra wound for the duration of the battle. This may take the Wounds of a Necromancer above their original maximum value, but a Liche may only restore lost wounds. This spell will not affect the Possessed or any Undead models.

spells.name: Reanimation
spells.effect: One Zombie that went out of action during the last hand to hand combat phase immediately returns to battle. Place the model within 6" of the sorcerer. The model cannot be placed straight into hand to hand combat with an enemy model. This spell can be used on Grave Guards and Wights to restore 1 lost wound (should they have more than one). This cannot be used to bring Scarecrows, Grave Guards, Wights and Skeletons back to life if they are taken out of action the way Zombies can.

spells.name: Spell of Doom
spells.effect: Chose one enemy model within 12". The model must immediately roll equal to or less than his Strength on a D6 or the dead emerging from the earth will rend him with supernatural power. If he fails, you may roll on the Injury table to see what happens to the unfortunate warrior.

spells.name: Call of Vanhel
spells.effect: A single Zombie, Skeleton, Wight or Grave Guard within 6" of the caster may immediately move again up to its maximum movement distance. If this moves them into base contact with an enemy model then it counts as charging. The targeted Zombie, Skeleton, Wight or Grave Guard will automatically pass Initiative tests needed to be made during this extra movement.

spells.name: Deathly Visage (Necromancers only)
spells.effect: The Necromancer causes fear in his enemies for the duration of the battle and is likewise immune to fear. This spell is the one exception to the Apprentice rule that Necromancers must usually follow when in a Liche warband. A Necromancer may choose this spell if the Liche has the spell Horror.

spells.name: Living Horror (Liche only)
spells.effect: You may choose one model within 8" of the Liche and roll D6+3. If this score is equal to or greater than the Leadership of the target model, then that model suffers a Wound, no armour saves allowed. If this wounds the target and they still have Wounds remaining, then that target may not move, shoot or cast spells during their next turn unless they pass a Leadership test. This spell will not affect the Possessed, Undead, or any model that is immune to fear.

norseRunes.name: Norse Runes
norseRunes.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Howl of the North
spells.effect: The Shaman is immune to all missile fire. Roll a dice during the Shaman's recovery phase. On a roll of 1 or 2 the winds dissipate.

spells.name: Angvar's Fury
spells.effect: All warriors within 8" of the Shaman gain a +1 to hit in hand-to-hand combat against the opposing warband. The spell lasts till the start of the Norse players next turn.

spells.name: Elvek's Cold Spear
spells.effect: The icicle has a range of 18" and causes one S4 hit. It strikes the first model in its path. Normal armour saves apply.

spells.name: Gift of the Fates
spells.effect: The Shaman may adjust one die roll by +1/-1 between a successful casting of this rune and his next recovery phase. A 'to wound' roll adjusted to or from 6 will not cause a critical.

spells.name: Kiss of Frost
spells.effect: A single model within 12" of the Shaman must pass an Initiative test or be knocked down.

spells.name: Bear's Might
spells.effect: The Shaman gains +1 Attack, +2 Strength, +2 Toughness and loses -2 Initiative (to a minimum of 1). Take a Leadership test at the beginning of each turn (both yours and your opponent's). If the test fails, Bear's Might drains away. Bear's Might can only be cast successfully once per game.

onogalRituals.name: Onogal Rituals
onogalRituals.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Touch of Onogal
spells.effect: This spell can be used against one of the Seer's close combat opponents. If he takes the model out of action in the following hand-to-hand combat phase, that player rolls for Serious Injuries immediately. If the model dies permanently, replace it with a Nurgle Plague Bearer (see Bestiary for rules) for the rest of the game under the Seer's control. If the Seer is stunned or taken out of action the Plague Bearer disappears into the Realm of Chaos. Note that only one Plague Bearer can be created at a time.

spells.name: Buboes
spells.effect: This spell has a range of 8" and affects a single enemy warrior. The warrior must pass a Toughness test or lose a Wound. No Armour saves are allowed.

spells.name: Stench of Nurgle
spells.effect: This spell has a range of 6" and affects all living creatures - friend or foe. Each enemy warrior in range must pass a Toughness test or lose an Attack until their next turn.

spells.name: Pestilence
spells.effect: All enemy models within 12" of the Master suffer a Strength 3 hit. No Armour saves are allowed.

spells.name: Scabrous Hide
spells.effect: The Master has an armour save of 2+ which replaces any normal Armour save. The Scabrous Hide lasts until the beginning of his next Shooting phase.

spells.name: Nurgle's Rot
spells.effect: All enemy models in base contact with the Master must immediately test against their Toughness or contract Nurgle's Rot (see Nurgle's Rot).

prayersOfUlric.name: Prayers of Ulric
prayersOfUlric.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Snow Squall
spells.effect: All enemy models in Hand-to-Hand combat with the priest are at -1 to hit due to the swirling snow and winds. The spell lasts for the duration of the Hand-to-Hand combat.

spells.name: Hammerschlag
spells.effect: That model suffers a S4 attack from an enormous ethereal hammer, including the concussion special rule.

spells.name: Bloodlust
spells.effect: All attacks are at S + 2, and he scores a critical hit on a 5-6. The Wolf Priest must test, by rolling the prayer's difficulty or greater on 2d6, each turn to see if the prayer remains in effect.

spells.name: Wolf's Hunger
spells.effect: One member of the warband (priest's choice) is thrown into a Frenzy.

spells.name: Ulric's Howl
spells.effect: For the duration of the battle, all members of the priest's warband are immune to Fear and all alone tests as they feel the presence of their god. Additionally, all Rout tests are at +1.

spells.name: Call of Ulric
spells.effect: The Wolf Priest lets out a cry of agony as his body re-shapes itself into that of a huge, slavering wolf with the following profile: Profile | M | WS | BS | S | T | W | I | A | Ld; Wolf | 6 | 4 | 0 | 4 | 4 | 1 | 5 | 2 | 6; During the time that the priest is in the form of a wolf, he may do nothing but attack as a wolf: no spell-casting or weapons use. He still hates Sigmar's minions though. In each shooting phase, the priest may choose to make a Leadership test (using the Wolfs Ld 6) to regain his human form. If he is still in wolf form at the end of the battle, he gets one last chance to return to human form. If he does not, then he remains a wolf forever! He is still a hero, and thus entitled to XP gains and attribute increases. He may only choose skills from the Speed Table, with the exception of Scale Sheer Surfaces.

ritualsOfHashut.name: Rituals of Hashut
ritualsOfHashut.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Sacrificial Ritual
spells.effect: The Chaos Dwarf Sorcerer must be in contact with an Engine of Chaos in order to successfully cast this spell. As the ritual requires the sacrifice of a mortal, remove one captive model from the Engine of Chaos and its starting warband's roster. The Sorcerer may sacrifice additional captives to lower the spell's difficulty by -1 per sacrifice. These models must be sacrificed before rolling for Difficulty. The Chaos Dwarf Sorcerer gains +D3 Experience.

spells.name: Spirit of Hashut
spells.effect: The player draws a line 18" from the Sorcerer. All models crossed by the line, suffer one S4 hit.

spells.name: Bellow of Doom
spells.effect: All models engaged in base contact with the sorcerer must make an immediate Ld test or break from combat and run.

spells.name: Fumes of Azgorh
spells.effect: The spell has a range of 8", hitting all models in its path on a D6 score of 4+. Any model hit suffers a S4 hit, roll to wound as normal. No armour saves allowed.

spells.name: Flickering Hide
spells.effect: The Sorcerer may cast this spell upon himself or any one model within 6". The flaming hide will negate any one wound suffered on a D6 roll of 4+. In hand-to-hand combat, any model which hits the flaming hide will suffer one S3 hit for each hit scored. The Flaming Hide lasts until the beginning of the Sorcerer's next shooting phase.

spells.name: Lava Flow
spells.effect: The Sorcerer may move 12" in any direction, even into combat, counting as a charge. However, due to the nature of this spell the Sorcerer may only reappear on or below the ground.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.effect: All models within 3" of the Sorcerer, friend or foe alike, must roll equal to or under their Initiative or suffer D3 S4 hits.

shadowWarriorMagic.name: Shadow Warrior Magic
shadowWarriorMagic.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Pool of Shadow
spells.effect: The spell fills the area around the mage with twisting shadows. The mage and all models within 6" may Hide as if there were a wall or obstruction between them and their enemies. They may Hide even after marching. If an enemy enters the area the effect is disrupted. While the spell lasts all affected models count as being in cover against enemy shooting. The spell lasts until the start of the Shadow Weaver's next turn.

spells.name: The Living Shadows
spells.effect: The Shadow Weaver may cast this spell at any enemy model within 12" and within 2" of a wall. The target suffers a single Strength 4 hit with no armour saves.

spells.name: Wings of Night
spells.effect: This spell may only be cast if the Shadow Weaver is within 2" of a wall. He is instantly moved up to 12" to a position that is also within 2" of a wall. If the move places him into base contact with an enemy model he counts as charging in the first round of combat.

spells.name: Cloak of Darkness
spells.effect: The Shadow Weaver is concealed from enemy sight. As long as he does not attack enemy models (cast spells, shoot, or fight in close combat) he may not be attacked. He may intercept as normal if desired, but he is not required to do so. If he does not intercept, enemies may charge past him. The spell lasts until the Shadow Weaver attacks an enemy model. A model engaged in close combat may never choose not to attack.

spells.name: Shadowbind
spells.effect: The Shadow Weaver may cast this spell at any enemy model within 24" and within 2" of a wall. The target may not move unless it first passes a Strength test on 1D6+1 at the start of its turn before the Recovery phase. The spell lasts until the Shadow Weaver suffers a wound or attempts to cast another spell. If the affected model is attacked, treat it exactly as if it were Stunned.

spells.name: Shield of Shadow
spells.effect: The Shadow Weaver may cast this spell on himself or a member of his warband within 12". The target gains a 5+ armour save that is not modified by the attacker's Strength. The spell lasts until the start of the Shadow Weaver's next turn.

shornaalRituals.name: Shornaal Rituals
shornaalRituals.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Delicious Suffering
spells.effect: All models (friend and foe, except for the Seer) within 3" must pass a Ld test or are knocked down.

spells.name: Dance of the Serpent
spells.effect: All enemy models that are not immune to psychology suffer a -1 'to hit' against him in close combat. The Dance lasts until the beginning of the Seer's next shooting phase.

spells.name: Endless Torment
spells.effect: Choose one enemy model within 8". From now on the model must roll for injury -1 after it's Recovery phase. For the duration of the Torment the Seer can do nothing else but end the spell at the beginning of his turn and if attacked in close combat, he is hit automatically and the spell breaks.

spells.name: Mystify
spells.effect: Target enemy model within 8" will have their Initiative value reduced to 1 and will always strike last in close combat, even if they charge an opponent or are armed with a spear or pike and are charged themselves. This spell lasts until the target passes a Ld test during the recovery phase.

spells.name: A Thousand Voices
spells.effect: Choose one enemy model within 12". For the duration of the spell the model reduces it's Ld by D3 +1 (to a minimum of 2) if it is not immune to psychology. The model must pass a Ld test at the beginning of it's turn to end the spell. The spell breaks also when the Seer loses a wound. A thousand Voices can only enchant one model at a time.

spells.name: Shornaal's Temptation
spells.effect: Choose one enemy model within 8" that is not immune to psychology. The model must pass a Ld test. If the model fails, then the Seer gains control over the model. The player may attempt to regain control at the beginning of his turn by passing a Ld test. Shornaal's Temptation can only enchant one model at a time. If the Seer is hit whether by a missile or in close combat he must pass a Ld test or the spell ends.❓

spellsOfTheDjedhi.name: Spells of the Djed'hi
spellsOfTheDjedhi.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Divination of Shirath
spells.effect: The Mage may re-roll all his failed dice rolls, though the second result stands. The effect lasts until the beginning of the Mage's next turn.

spells.name: Shimmering Shield
spells.effect: This spell acts as a shield to protect the Mage. It gives him an additional unmodified 5+ save against all attacks. The effect lasts until the beginning of the Mage's next turn.

spells.name: Statue of Light
spells.effect: The Mage chooses a single enemy model he can see. That model may not move as long as the Mage remains both static and alive. The Mage and the target may cast spells normally, but fight in close combat at -2 WS (minimum of 1).

spells.name: Fleeting Shadows
spells.effect: The first time the Mage is hit in close combat or shooting, the spell protects him and the hit is ignored. Move the Mage 2" from his current position in a random direction (but not off a cliff, etc). This is where he really was all along. The spell remains in play until it saves the Mage from a hit, whereupon it is dispelled. It may not be cast again whilst it is in play.

spells.name: Hunter's Fury
spells.effect: The spell summons D3+1 arrows which the Mage can use to shoot against one enemy model following the rules for normal shooting. The arrows have a range of 36". Use the Mage's own Ballistic Skill to determine whether he hits or not, but ignore movement, range and cover penalties. Each arrow causes one S3 hit.

spells.name: Silent Guardian
spells.effect: This spell acts as an invisible guardian that will defend the Mage. If the Mage is attacked in close combat then the guardian will fight first with WS5, S3. The guardian will make 1 attack per turn against each enemy that attacks the Mage. The guardian will not leave the Mage's side, and will only fight if the Mage himself is being attacked. The Guardian cannot be attacked in return and will only be dispelled if the Mage casts another spell or dies.

tcharRituals.name: Tchar Rituals
tcharRituals.source: The Mordheimer (mordheimer.net) magic and prayer lists

spells.name: Tchar's Blessing
spells.effect: This spell must be used before the game and may only be used once. The Seer may not cast spells in the following battle. After the game he gains D3 Experience points if he wasn't taken out of action.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.effect: The Seer ends all effects of currently active spells.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.effect: This spell must be used before the game and may only be used once. Choose a warband. One randomly determined Hero of that warband must miss the following game. Models that are capable of casting spells or prayers are immune to this effect.

spells.name: Wrath of the Great Eagle
spells.effect: Choose one enemy model within 12". The model is hit with a Strength equal to the difference of the Seer's Experience points and the model's Experience (to a maximum of 10). Armour saves are taken as normal. If the victim has more Experience points than the Seer, the latter is hit instead.

spells.name: Tchar's Reward
spells.effect: The Seer gets +1 on any one stat per 10 Experience points he has. Each stat may be increased only once through this spell.❓ The power of Tchar's Reward lasts until the end of the Seer's next shooting phase and can be re-cast in that phase.

spells.name: Slave to Chaos
spells.effect: This spell has a range of 12" and causes one Strength 2 hit with no armour save. If the model is taken out of action roll for Serious Injuries immediately. If they die replace the killed warrior with a Horror of Tzeentch (see Bestiary for rules) until the end of the game. If the Seer is stunned or taken out of action the Horror disappears into the Realm of Chaos.
